review_status: draft: written with AI assistance, awaiting human review
notes: round: self_introduction | behavioural | technical | motivation_fit. focus is what the question tests; it is embedded with MiniLM and matched to job requirements. tags are exact terms that link to requirement keywords. slots are filled from the user's own data: job_title, project, strength, gap, eligibility. key_points are what a good technical answer covers; they are used for scoring and are not shown before answering.
